description: Implementation of the F1AP DU UE Context Setup Procedure handling UE context setup requests, responses, and failures in a 5G network component.

classes.name: f1ap_du_ue_context_setup_procedure
classes.description: Handles the UE context setup procedure including request processing, response, and failure handling.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main procedure handling the UE context setup request, including UE context creation, configuration, and RRC container handling.

methods.name: handle_rrc_container
methods.description: Handles sending the RRC container to the UE via SRB1.

methods.name: get_cell_index_from_nr_cgi
methods.description: Retrieves cell index from NR CGI.

methods.name: request_du_ue_config
methods.description: Constructs and sends a request to configure UE in the DU.

methods.name: send_ue_context_setup_response
methods.description: Sends a successful UE context setup response.

methods.name: send_ue_context_setup_failure
methods.description: Sends a failure message for UE context setup.
